# Times of India

> India's leading English-language news platform delivering breaking news, live updates, and comprehensive coverage across politics, business, sports, and local city news.

Times of India (TOI) is India's largest circulated English newspaper with a robust digital presence. The platform provides real-time news coverage across multiple Indian cities, international news from the US and Middle East, weather forecasts, and specialized content through initiatives like TOISA 2025 and Ecopreneur Awards 2026.

## Key Topics

- Times of India
- Breaking News
- Live Updates
- Delhi
- India News
- City News

- TOISA 2025

## Core & Homepage

- [Times of India Homepage](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com): Times of India homepage with multi-language news coverage and live updates

## City News & Local Updates

- [India City News Hub](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city): Hub for local news from Indian cities with trending stories and updates
- [Delhi News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/delhi): Delhi local news with live updates on crime, politics and weather
- [Mumbai News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai): Mumbai breaking news covering crime, weather, transport and elections
- [Bengaluru News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bangalore): Bengaluru city news covering crime, education, politics and real estate
- [Hyderabad News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/hyderabad): Hyderabad news with live updates on politics, crime and weather
- [Kolkata News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kolkata): Kolkata breaking news covering crime, Durga Puja and local events
- [Chennai News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai): Chennai local news on politics, crime, education and real estate
- [Ahmedabad News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad): Ahmedabad Gujarat news on crime, education, politics and real estate
- [Bhubaneswar News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bhubaneswar): Bhubaneswar Odisha news with breaking updates and local headlines

## Crime & Investigation News

- [Crime News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/crime-news): Crime news aggregator covering arrests, investigations and police reports

## International & Regional News

- [US News](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/us): US news section with breaking coverage of elections, politics, business and sports
- [Middle East News (GCC Edition)](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/gcc): GCC edition covering Middle East, Bollywood, sports and business news

## Weather & Environment

- [Weather Forecasts](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/weather): Real-time weather forecasts for Delhi, Mumbai, Gurgaon with AQI alerts
